source_pool.selection: 8 evenly spaced size ranks among first 32 rows, after conservative credential-like-content exclusion

contract.chat_template: Qwen3.5 thinking-enabled; tokenize fixed input deltas and original assistant bodies independently; structural closing delimiters are fixed input
contract.history: Actual generated token IDs, then next source input delta; no generated-text retokenization or history rerendering
contract.output_policy: Exact source-derived per-turn token budget, greedy ignore_eos; native real MTP accept/reject if enabled; never forced synthetic acceptance
contract.arrival: Closed-loop C continuously replenished HTTP request lanes; one request per session; no original tool/human delays; cyclic whole-session queue
contract.cache: Unique salt and sticky routing identity per play; preserved within session; cross-session common-prefix reuse deliberately excluded
contract.warmup: Separate short protocol/cache qualification before measured traffic. Measured sessions start with fresh salts, no primers. No one-hour formal window.
contract.aggregation: One unpooled 900s observation per point; count actual output tokens received inside window, drain only already in-flight requests; no post-window token credit
contract.x_axis: P90 across fully completed in-window requests of (N-1)/(last-token-time-first-token-time); grouped SSE token times, not inverse P90 TPOT
contract.y_axis: In-window generated tokens / 900 seconds / every allocated chip
contract.acceptance: All exact prompt-ID echoes, budget/usage/DONE checks pass; no request errors, verified prefix reuse and owned-resource release. Not answer-quality or peak-capacity certification.
contract.context_scope: 262144 configured capacity; eight full shapes end at 15494..141269 tokens. Short-window observed prompt lengths are recorded per point; no claim that each run reaches full 256K.
contract.limitations: Small deterministic size-spread sample; cold-start/finite-window request mixes and reached context differ across loads/engines. Shared-host single observations; natural MTP output content may differ. Historical AgentX results are a separate workload.
contract.status: 15-minute smoke, tuning incomplete; retained historical native C16 functional caveats apply; not SWE task solving
contract.prepared_workload_equivalence: Direct structural comparison: all360 fixed input-ID deltas, output budgets, session ordering, source identity and policy identical. Files differ only in tokenizer path/version metadata; tokenizer fingerprint identical. Exact file identity retained per point.
contract.client_versions: 0.1.0 routes session affinity by cache_salt at relay;0.1.1 additionally sends X-Correlation-ID equal to that salt. Same sticky-play policy; exact revision/transport retained per point.

source_pool.filtering: No additional filtering, clipping or output-budget reduction

contract.arrival: Official closed-loop session DAG replay; original relative delays; concurrency counts session trees, not HTTP requests; concurrent loads may be swept as distinct points
contract.warmup: Per-point benchmark_protocol: historical pressure10-v1 or snapshot-primers-v2. Both exclude warmup from the 900s window.
contract.output_policy: Full requested measured outputs; ignore_eos=true; greedy. MTP0 or benchmark-only synthetic MTP2/AL2.63 is recorded per point.
contract.acceptance: Official harness submission_valid=true, no request errors or output-length mismatches; not model answer-quality evaluation
contract.aggregation: One unpooled smoke observation per point. Hardware count, load, runtime, graph, cache, MTP and warmup may differ; inspect point configuration. Not repeats, causal ablation or a tuned peak-capacity certification.
contract.status: Short smoke; tuning incomplete; no one-hour formal result
contract.cost: Not priced; output tokens/s/chip is resource productivity, not revenue
contract.protocol_scope: Shared corpus and 900s smoke window; warmup and speculation are per-point settings. One throughput comparison view, not an identical-protocol causal comparison.
contract.checkpoint_provenance: HF 712cf743 and the ModelScope content manifest are accepted as the same Qwen3.5-35B-A3B model for this throughput view by Fletcher (2026-09-24). Actual source identity stays per point; no byte-equality claim.
